equation.label: Power series centered atx=ax=a
equation.formula: $${\sum\limits_{n = 0}^{\infty}{c_{n}\left( {x - a} \right)^{n}}} = c_{0} + c_{1}\left( {x - a} \right) + c_{2}\left( {x - a} \right)^{2} + \text{⋯}$$

equation.label: Taylor series for the functionffat the pointx=ax=a
equation.formula: $${\sum\limits_{n = 0}^{\infty}\frac{f^{(n)}(a)}{n\text{!}}}\left( {x - a} \right)^{n} = f(a) + f^{\prime}(a)\left( {x - a} \right) + \frac{f^{''}(a)}{2\text{!}}\left( {x - a} \right)^{2} + \text{⋯} + \frac{f^{(n)}(a)}{n\text{!}}\left( {x - a} \right)^{n} + \text{⋯}$$
